verdict.rationale: Zamzar's documented REST API lets a script or pipeline run conversions without any UI. It uses API-key Bearer/Basic auth, a `jobs` endpoint, polling with a timeout, and download-and-delete flows, plus an official Java SDK and a sandbox environment, all of which suit unattended automation. Missing for 10: an official CLI or CI integration (e.g. a GitHub Action), explicit CI/headless guidance, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.
